description: Type the 409 `idempotency_key_reused` a create or fork gets when an Idempotency-Key is reused with a different request body. The spec documents it on the Idempotency-Key parameter ("reusing a key with a **different body** returns `409` `idempotency_key_reused`"), which POST /sandboxes and POST /sandboxes/{sandboxId}/fork take; it generated as a bare Conflict. Source: spec-mirror-boat-dev 71ab00f, components.parameters.IdempotencyKey.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: This Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request body. Use a new key.
